problem_statement: Build a brand-new Workspace Preferences page from scratch at the /preferences route of this Sneat Vuetify + Vue 3 admin template. The route does not exist yet — today it falls through to the catch-all 404 view. Construct the full page inside the site's existing dashboard shell (vertical nav + top navbar + footer) and reuse the Vuetify design system already used across the template (VCard, VCardText, VBtnToggle/VBtn, VChip, VAvatar, VIcon, VTable, the text-h4/text-h5/text-body typography and the primary colour tokens). The page must present an availability-profile toggle (Focused / Balanced / Open) that actually drives the content: switching the profile must swap the profile heading, the tagline, the four summary KPI cards and the notification-routing table rows. It must also render without horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: A page title 'Workspace Preferences' with a short introductory blurb, sitting inside the existing dashboard shell
An availability-profile toggle group offering exactly three options labelled Focused, Balanced and Open
A prominent profile heading (h3) that names the currently selected profile, e.g. 'Balanced workspace profile', accompanied by a status chip

A one-line tagline (a

) under the heading describing the selected profile's intent — e.g. the Balanced profile's tagline describes a mix of collaboration time and protected focus time (the word 'focus' should appear)

A row of four summary KPI cards (daily focus blocks, meeting cap, notification mode, quiet hours) each with an icon, label and value; the default Balanced profile shows a daily-focus-blocks value of "2 blocks", and Focused shows "4 blocks"
A 'Notification routing' card containing a table that lists each channel and how it behaves under the active profile
Selecting a different profile re-renders the heading, tagline, the four KPI card values and the routing table rows to that profile's data
The whole page sits inside the dashboard shell (vertical nav + top navbar + footer), consistent with the existing pages
design_constraints: Reuse Vuetify components already used by the template (VCard, VCardText, VBtnToggle, VBtn, VChip, VAvatar, VIcon, VTable, VRow/VCol)
Keep the template's colour palette, spacing and typography (text-h4/text-h5/text-h6/text-body, primary colour); do not introduce a new visual language
Mount the page inside the existing default layout (vertical nav + navbar + footer) via a new route in src/plugins/router/routes.js

Use the template primary colour token #696cff (rgb(105,108,255)) for the active profile toggle / chip / accents, and the default body text colour rgba(34,48,62,0.9) on a white (#ffffff) / light (#f5f5f9) surface — do not introduce off-palette colours
author_notes: 方案A: baseline /preferences 挂一个顶层空页 (src/pages/preferences.vue = <div/>, 注册为 layout 外的顶层 route) → 渲染空白，不走 catch-all 的 [...error].vue (那会出 404 文本、跳 check A + forbidden_text)。reference 完整实现 profile 切换（VBtnToggle 驱动 computed profile，默认 balanced）。bad 把 onSelect 改为 no-op（点击不切换）→ 默认态 DOM 断言全过但 interaction_assertions 失败。该 repo NON-file-based routing (手写 routes.js，无 unplugin-vue-router)；app 在 javascript-version/ 子目录，project_root 需强制指向 javascript-version（删 typescript-version + 改 .sitecontinuum_workspace.json）。manifest 原 pnpm+空命令，已改为 npm。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。route 无 basename，state path = /preferences。
